feature.level_2: Data, Benchmarks, Curriculum, and Observability (Active Learning / Hard-Case Mining / Credit Assignment)
feature.description: Improves task coverage, difficulty, data quality, and change attribution. Validate with coverage, contamination, trace, and ablation tests.

contract.purpose_user_function: Improve task/data/benchmark coverage and change attribution using hard cases, observability traces, and controlled comparisons.
contract.valid_inputs: Task corpus, benchmark registry/results, failures/hard cases, labels/metadata, observability events, candidate curriculum/data change, and ablation plan.
contract.expected_outputs: Coverage/quality/contamination report, prioritized cases, candidate dataset/curriculum, ablation/attribution evidence, and recommendation.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes benchmark reports, scorecards, events, and possibly curated data artifacts after approval.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Contamination, unverifiable labels, missing provenance, biased coverage, no attributable improvement, or benchmark regression rejects change.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Benchmark and telemetry infrastructure is shipped; a unified active-learning/hard-case-mining/credit-assignment engine is not.
contract.success_evidence: Coverage and ablation reports use traceable data, exclude contamination, and demonstrate attributable improvement under guardrails.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: coverage; contamination; hard-case selection; trace completeness; ablation; attribution; regression; promotion.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/evolution_engine.py: scorecard(), promote(), demote_degraded(), recommend(), run_loop(); harness/tools/skill_evolution_runner.py: run_once(); core/nerve/evolution-engine.ts: EvolutionEngine

contract.platform_provider_limitations: Generic evidence, scorecard, evaluation-pack, promotion, and rollback controls are local; named optimization/training algorithms may need optional integrations, datasets, model providers, accelerators, or are absent.
